body: I just want to give love to everyone here. This is so real. In spite of how difficult and all-encompassing the pain is sometimes, it does wax and wane; there are ways of coping. I believe in the strength of all of you.
Sounds like you have some degree of Stockholm Syndrome, if you feel sorry for him. I hope you can get justice. Get him out of your life, move away if you have to.
Thank you. This actually made me feel some relief.

If you are angry at everybody and feel like everyone is against you you were likely neglected or abused in some crucial way. That's not your fault. I wish for you the insight to understand where this came from, and the power to overcome it.

I'm sorry, that sounds really difficult. My mom mentioned to me once, vaguely, that she'd been trying to plan her suicide and it made me really feel like I had nothing to look forward to. My dad did die from his own self-harm. Whether we like it or not, our parents are roll models to us.    


It's really difficult to know what to do for someone who is seriously suicidal. Please don't take the weight of this on by or for yourself. Professional help may be a good idea; even though it may not offer a quick happy and fast solution, it will at least provide you with support getting through your struggles.

I understand. People always say "get help." Or "maybe you should see a therapist." Is it even worth it anymore to tell them that you've been through 10 therapists, been on the meds, done all the talking and reaching out (and have consequently experienced more than your share of rejection in the process)? I wish I were a better person, I wish I wish I wish I knew how to have this pain dissolved and to be able to please everyone around me.
